finding: All four doors name a principal and carry an explicit chain, and the non-interactive ones do not collapse into one machine account -- the schedule names the person who authorised it and the external door names the partner agent above intake above that person -- which is the half of the aligned anchor that holds. Nothing establishes it, though: the actor is a declared field of the envelope that dispatch copies forward, no credential is presented or verified at any door, identity.resolve is a recorded no-op at all four, two of the four chains would in fact be refused as unrooted by this repo's own identity interface, and the first outbound model call carries one shared environment bearer rather than a token exchanged from the entry principal.
gap: No entry authenticates. A door accepts a self-asserted subject, so the four principals are claims rather than facts, and because nothing is exchanged from them the downstream model call cannot say for whom it is acting. What is missing is a presented credential on the envelope that work-intake resolves through identity.verify at admission, the resulting actor carried as the subject of a delegate call before each model or tool call, and the entry fixtures fixed so their chains root in direct or workload_attestation.
